provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Great Western Trail: New Zealand rulebook (eggertspiele, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Game board with the sea routes board above it
5 random harbourmaster tiles faceup on the sea routes board; box the other 3
8 neutral building tiles on the neutral spaces
steps.note: First game: each on its matching letter A-H

steps.text: Bonus tiles market token on the top dashed round space
Worker, hazard and bonus tiles into the A and B bags by their backs (the Wellington supply)
One A worker of each type on the top row of the job market
Draw {n} A tiles: hazards to the lowest empty space of their section, workers to the top empty space of their column; redraw if no room
Draw B bonus tiles into the market from the space under your player count sign up to the market token
Player board; player count tile and fee tile (-1/-2 side) in the Phase A box
10 private building tiles above your board in ascending craftsmen order
16 discs and 10 storehouses covering your board's spaces; ship on a starting water space; certificate marker on 0; gold marker on 1; runholder beside your board
Shuffle your 14 sheep cards as your draw stack
In turn order: 7/8/9/10 pounds and 4/5/6/7 cards, plus 1 exchange token each
On your first turn: discard down to 4 cards, put a white-cornered disc on 0 of the pathfinder track, place your runholder on any neutral building and continue with phase B
